cicd-aiops 0.1.0 (Initial Release)

- Launches a preview skill for governed CI/CD operations on self-managed GitLab and Gitea servers.
- Supports unified read and write actions: server, project, pipeline, runner, repository, artifact, RCA, and governance/audit operations.
- Includes four flagship RCA tools (pipeline failure, runner health, storage bloat, stale work) delivering transparent heuristics.
- All state-changing operations are audited, policy-checked, and risk-tiered using a bundled governance harness.
- Credentials are encrypted at rest; never stored as plaintext.
- Preview mode: mock-validated only; not run against live servers.
